summary: The Agreement module implements the data structures and operations for managing agreements, templates, and their workflows in a system. It enables searching, listing, creating, updating, and deleting agreement records, including template and content user associations. The module manages display logic for agreement templates and history, supports workflow grouping, and integrates business rules around access, status, and content authorship.
purpose: To provide comprehensive management and workflow for agreements including templates, statuses, content authors, agency associations, expiration, review scheduling, and historical tracking within the system.

workflows.name: Agreement Search Template
steps: Call agreement search procedure with parameters for template and status filtering
Iterate through results, build Agreement objects
Manage template display, edit and history logic based on access and status
Group agreements by type and description
Return list and group metadata

workflows.name: Agreement Creation
steps: Call AgreementAdd procedure with session and agreement metadata
Read returned AgreementID
Return new Agreement record

workflows.name: Agreement Update
steps: Call AgreementUpdate procedure with session, agreement ID, review date, status, content authors, and other fields
Execute update

workflows.name: Agreement Delete
steps: Call AgreementDelete procedure with session and agreement ID
Execute deletion

workflows.name: Agreement Listing
steps: Call AgreementSearchAgreement procedure with filters for status, type, description, etc.
Iterate through results, build Agreement objects
Format fields for display

workflows.name: Agreement Grouping
steps: Identify group headers
Track start and end index per group
Set client toggle click logic
Build group metadata string

workflows.name: Content Author and Agency Listing
steps: Fetch appropriate content user lists based on agency and agreement parameters
Build ItemList objects

business_rules: Only CA users can access or list agreements from other agencies
Inactive agreements use alternate display imaging and tooltip
Template records existence and edit permissions control available actions
Status subscriber field controls display of subscription imagery and tooltips
Expiry and review dates are conditionally formatted
validations: Check agreement type and description IDs when creating or updating
Validate user permissions for editing, viewing, and deleting
calculations: Toggle client click logic for groupings
conditions: AgreementExists=true: show template and history, else edit or invisible depending on user rights
Inactive: special image and tooltip shown
DisplayDate==2 and LastUpdated<DateTime.Today: show date in red
system_behavior: Retrieves, creates, updates, and deletes agreements via stored procedures
Builds agreement, template, and history URLs for UI navigation
Groups agreements by type and description
Formats display based on status, template existence, and inactivity
exceptions: If agreement record does not exist, disables editing and history actions
If agency user lacks permission, restricts visibility of certain agreements
content_gaps: No explicit UI layout or user interaction details
No error handling logic for database failures
No business rule explanations for status transitions
